description: Create Helm Command Deck widget and tool plugins from a prompt with the @usetdt/helm-sdk CLI.
author: Charl Gottschalk

dependencies.name: Helm SDK
dependencies.purpose: Scaffold, build and validate plugins (`npx @usetdt/helm-sdk`); ships the contracts the skills read.

dependencies.name: Helm
dependencies.purpose: Install the finished plugin with `helm plugin link`; the user reviews, approves and enables it in Helm.

dependencies.name: Node.js
dependencies.purpose: Run the SDK CLI with npx and npm.

capabilities.scope: The new plugin folder under work/helm/plugins/<id>/ (sources, dist/ and node_modules/).
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold and fill in the widget or tool the user asked for.
capabilities.data_leaves_machine: Context selected by the agent may be sent to the configured model provider.

capabilities.scope: The plugin folder and the SDK docs installed in it.
capabilities.purpose: Follow the Helm contracts while writing the plugin.
capabilities.data_leaves_machine: Context selected by the agent may be sent to the configured model provider.

capabilities.scope: npx/npm (create, install, build) in the plugin folder; `helm plugin link` only when the user asks to install.
capabilities.purpose: Build and validate the plugin, and install it into Helm.
capabilities.data_leaves_machine: npm downloads @usetdt/helm-sdk and its dependencies from the npm registry; no workspace data is sent.
